text.jp:
黒曜の力で得体のしれぬ魔獣を呼び出し、
使役しようなどと、危険が大きすぎまする。
text.official_en:
The risks in using Obsidian to summon Demonic
Beasts are too great.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの怪異、世の理から大きく
外れたもののようにそれがしは思えます。
text.official_en:
That Phantom... It is far removed from the laws of
this world.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それに、もし仮に
それらをうまく使いこなせたとしても……
text.official_en:
Even if you can control the beasts effectively, I fear
what it will cost you.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
レダ嬢、次の対戦相手のアレキサンドラには
くれぐれも気をつけておくことだ。
text.official_en:
We'll want to pay careful attention to what
Alexandra, our next opponent, might do.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ジュラ神殿のテルス白銀騎士団といえば、
もともと凄腕で名は高いのだが……
text.official_en:
The Silver Knights of Tellus, from Jurah's temple,
were at one point known for their superior skill.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼女のこれまでの試合……あまりにも
不戦勝が多すぎる。
text.official_en:
But too many of her matches have been won
by default.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
そういえばボク、ダグシオンの街で、
お母さんに会うことができたんだ。
text.official_en:
Guess what? I ran into my mom. She was here
in Dagsion.

text.jp: <NCA>それはよかった
text.official_en: <NCA>Say that's good.

text.jp: <NCB>その割には浮かない顔だ
text.official_en: <NCB>Ask why she's not more thrilled.

text.jp:
<ACA>……うん、元気そうだったよ。
だけど、ちょっと喧嘩しちゃって……
text.official_en:
<ACA>Yeah. She seemed alright, but we kinda got into
an argument...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>だってお母さん、ボクの話なんか
全然聞いてくれないんだもの！
text.official_en: <ACB>Because she doesn't listen to a word I say!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ

text.jp:
もういい。ボクはやっぱり
レダさんについていくからね！
text.official_en:
Whatever—it doesn't matter. I'm sticking with
you, Leda!
text.real_en: That's enough. I'm going to stick with Leda-san after all!

text.jp:
この間街を歩いていた時に、
アレキサンドラを偶然見かけましたわ。
text.official_en:
I happened to run into Alexandra while I was taking
a walk through town.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……あたくしの目には、普通の、
裏のない、良い娘のように見えましたけども。
text.official_en:
She seemed to be a perfectly ordinary, honest young
woman with nothing to hide.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
シラクシオが何か言っておりましたけども、
あの男はいちいち勘ぐり過ぎなのですわ。
text.official_en:
I know Syracusio has his doubts, but he has his
doubts about everything.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
……妾がこの街のことを
嫌っていた理由を思い出したのだ。
text.official_en: I am reminded of why I so hated this town.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここは……妾たちダグザ神族にとって父である
ダグザ大帝が命じて造らせた街だ。
text.official_en:
The city was built by command of Dagda the
Great, father of the pantheon's gods.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この街にいると妾は、どうしても
父の存在を感じることが嫌だったのだ。
text.official_en:
I hated being here and feeling the unbearable weight
of his presence.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レイリダーナよ、其方は
自分の亡き父親のことは……愛しておるか？
text.official_en: Your late father, Leilidahna. Did you love him?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……そうか。正直なことを言うと、
妾は其方の事が少しうらやましい。
text.official_en: I see... In truth, I envy you a little.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、それだけに……
残念であったな、キジェルモのことは……
text.official_en:
Though of course it is a terrible shame what
happened to Guillermo...
text.real_en:
Though of course it is a terrible shame what
happened to Quijermo...
